title: Requirements structuring
activation: we agree what we want but never wrote down what finished looks like
write this up so a new engineer could build it without asking
the ticket just says make it faster, that is not enough
work will be built, bought, or committed to on the artifact's strength and requirements live in conversation or someone's head
write the requirements, spec this out, turn this idea into a PRD, acceptance criteria a stranger could verify
structure the outcomes, constraints, assumptions, and non-goals for a build we are committing to
standDown: requirements already obvious and small: rename a flag, flip a config, a well-understood fix
the real question is whether to build at all, not what
outcomes: a requirements artifact a stranger could verify against
inputs: the settled intent and its constraints
minimumEvidence: every load-bearing claim cites what it rests on or is marked unverified
escalation: whether to build is surfaced as a decision to frame, never specified around
